hook.en: Buying online feels like one click, but behind it are three stages: finding the product, placing and paying for the order, and getting it delivered.
hook.kn: ಆನ್‌ಲೈನ್ ಖರೀದಿ ಒಂದೇ ಕ್ಲಿಕ್‌ನಂತೆ ಕಾಣುತ್ತದೆ, ಆದರೆ ಅದರ ಹಿಂದೆ ಮೂರು ಹಂತಗಳಿವೆ: ವಸ್ತು ಹುಡುಕುವುದು, ಆರ್ಡರ್ ಮತ್ತು ಪಾವತಿ, ಮತ್ತು ವಿತರಣೆ.

objectives.en: Describe the stages of an online transaction
Explain the modes of online payment

narration.en: Buying online feels like one click, but behind it are three stages: finding the product, placing and paying for the order, and getting it delivered.
narration.kn: ಆನ್‌ಲೈನ್ ಖರೀದಿ ಒಂದೇ ಕ್ಲಿಕ್‌ನಂತೆ ಕಾಣುತ್ತದೆ, ಆದರೆ ಅದರ ಹಿಂದೆ ಮೂರು ಹಂತಗಳಿವೆ: ವಸ್ತು ಹುಡುಕುವುದು, ಆರ್ಡರ್ ಮತ್ತು ಪಾವತಿ, ಮತ್ತು ವಿತರಣೆ.

body.en: In the pre-purchase stage the buyer searches, compares and registers on the website. In the purchase stage the buyer places the order, usually through a shopping cart, and pays. In the delivery stage the goods are shipped and delivered; digital products such as e-books can be delivered online itself.

narration.en: In the pre-purchase stage the buyer searches, compares and registers on the website. In the purchase stage the buyer places the order, usually through a shopping cart, and pays. In the delivery stage the goods are shipped and delivered; digital products such as e-books can be delivered online itself.
narration.kn: ಆನ್‌ಲೈನ್ ವಹಿವಾಟಿಗೆ ಖರೀದಿಪೂರ್ವ, ಖರೀದಿ ಮತ್ತು ವಿತರಣೆ ಎಂಬ ಮೂರು ಹಂತಗಳಿವೆ.

body.en: Payment may be made by cash on delivery, by cheque, by net banking transfer, by credit or debit card, or by digital cash. In India, UPI payments from mobile phones are now very common. Card and bank payments pass through secure payment gateways.

narration.en: Payment may be made by cash on delivery, by cheque, by net banking transfer, by credit or debit card, or by digital cash. In India, UPI payments from mobile phones are now very common. Card and bank payments pass through secure payment gateways.
narration.kn: ಪಾವತಿಯನ್ನು ವಿತರಣೆಯ ವೇಳೆ ನಗದು, ಚೆಕ್, ನೆಟ್ ಬ್ಯಾಂಕಿಂಗ್, ಕ್ರೆಡಿಟ್ ಅಥವಾ ಡೆಬಿಟ್ ಕಾರ್ಡ್, ಅಥವಾ ಡಿಜಿಟಲ್ ನಗದಿನ ಮೂಲಕ ಮಾಡಬಹುದು.

problem.en: Arjun orders a pair of shoes listed at ₹2,400. The site gives 5% off for card payment and charges ₹60 for delivery. Find the amount he pays by card and name the stage at which payment happens.

steps.en: Add delivery: ₹2,280 + ₹60 = ₹2,340. Payment happens in the purchase stage.

narration.en: Let us work through this case together. Arjun orders a pair of shoes listed at ₹2,400. The site gives 5% off for card payment and charges ₹60 for delivery. Find the amount he pays by card and name the stage at which payment happens.

narration.kn: ಹಾಜರಿ ರಸಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ. ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕ್ರಮಸಂಖ್ಯೆ ಕರೆದಾಗ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಉತ್ತರ ಹೇಳಿ.

points.en: An online transaction has pre-purchase, purchase and delivery stages.
points.kn: ಆನ್‌ಲೈನ್ ವಹಿವಾಟಿಗೆ ಖರೀದಿಪೂರ್ವ, ಖರೀದಿ ಮತ್ತು ವಿತರಣೆ ಹಂತಗಳಿವೆ.

points.en: Payment: COD, cheque, net banking, cards or digital cash.
points.kn: ಪಾವತಿ: ವಿತರಣೆಯ ವೇಳೆ ನಗದು, ಚೆಕ್, ನೆಟ್ ಬ್ಯಾಂಕಿಂಗ್, ಕಾರ್ಡ್ ಅಥವಾ ಡಿಜಿಟಲ್ ನಗದು.

points.en: Digital cash exists only in electronic form.
points.kn: ಡಿಜಿಟಲ್ ನಗದು ವಿದ್ಯುನ್ಮಾನ ರೂಪದಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾತ್ರ ಇರುತ್ತದೆ.

homework.en: Describe the steps you would follow to buy a book online.

narration.en: Recap. An online transaction has pre-purchase, purchase and delivery stages. Payment: COD, cheque, net banking, cards or digital cash. Digital cash exists only in electronic form.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಆನ್‌ಲೈನ್ ವಹಿವಾಟಿಗೆ ಖರೀದಿಪೂರ್ವ, ಖರೀದಿ ಮತ್ತು ವಿತರಣೆ ಹಂತಗಳಿವೆ. ಪಾವತಿ: ವಿತರಣೆಯ ವೇಳೆ ನಗದು, ಚೆಕ್, ನೆಟ್ ಬ್ಯಾಂಕಿಂಗ್, ಕಾರ್ಡ್ ಅಥವಾ ಡಿಜಿಟಲ್ ನಗದು. ಡಿಜಿಟಲ್ ನಗದು ವಿದ್ಯುನ್ಮಾನ ರೂಪದಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾತ್ರ ಇರುತ್ತದೆ.
